governance_rule: TRANSFER → ACCEPTANCE → APPROVAL → CLOSE. No step may be skipped. ASSIGNED ≠ ACCEPTED. Per Agent E Post-700 Governance Model §2.2 and §4.1.

acceptance_evidence_standards.reference: Agent E Post-700 Governance Model §4.2 (Evidence of Acceptance) and §4.3 (What Does NOT Count as Acceptance)
valid_forms: Explicit 'I accept responsibility for [X]' statement by the receiving owner in a session transcript or dedicated acceptance session report
Governance Board or Executive Board resolution formally voting to accept the transferred responsibility
Signed entry in REVISION_HISTORY.md documenting the acceptance by the receiving owner
Entry in this registry (SESSION726_OWNERSHIP_ACCEPTANCE_REGISTRY.json) with accepted_by, accepted_date, and acceptance_evidence fields populated
invalid_forms: Naming a series or agent in a planning document without explicit acceptance statement
'Recommended assignment' or 'proposed owner' language — not accepted
'TBD', 'pending', or 'PENDING' in the Ownership Matrix or any acceptance field
Silence after transfer documentation — absence of objection is not acceptance
Assignment in SESSION725_OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.json alone (ASSIGNED ≠ ACCEPTED per Agent E §4.1)
acceptance_evidence_standards.acceptance_logged_when: Any valid form of acceptance is recorded → populate accepted_by, accepted_date, acceptance_evidence in this registry → update acceptance_status from PENDING to ACCEPTED.

stewardship_principles_referenced.principle_1: No Orphaned Responsibility — Every asset, file, process, and governance responsibility has exactly one named primary owner. Enforced by the Ownership Matrix as authoritative registry.
stewardship_principles_referenced.principle_2: Ownership Transfers Require Acceptance — Ownership cannot be transferred by assignment alone. Receiving party must explicitly accept. Unilateral assignment without acceptance is invalid. Original owner retains ownership until acceptance confirmed.
stewardship_principles_referenced.principle_3: Series Closure Requires Ownership Disposition — When any series closes, all artifacts and responsibilities must be explicitly disposed: transferred, retired, or converted to stewardship.
stewardship_principles_referenced.principle_4: Ownership Is Reviewable at Every Series Boundary Transition — At every transition between active portfolio lanes, the Ownership Matrix is reviewed for correctness.
stewardship_principles_referenced.principle_5: Single Point of Accountability per Responsibility — Every responsibility has exactly one primary owner. No responsibility is owned by a committee, shared between equals, or left to 'all lane owners' collectively.
stewardship_principles_referenced.source: Agent O Portfolio Stewardship Framework v1.0 §3
